evidence.clarity: 1440 first screen: H1 'Every licensed kitchen has hours it sits empty.' is an observation, not an offer; the lede ('Ovenhour rents them out... A small food maker books a shift') carries what/who, and the two CTAs name each audience ('I make food and need a kitchen' / 'I run a kitchen with empty hours').
evidence.fit: Both sides get a path: hero kitchen CTA and 'List your kitchen' go to the supplied https://ovenhour.example/kitchens; makers get a waiting-list form. County uncertainty has its own section ('Ovenhour hasn't announced launch counties yet... we won't guess'). The status block ('Listings: None yet') honours 'can't pretend there's anything to browse'. The maker form, though, behaves like a backend signup the client says does not exist.
evidence.distinctiveness: The hour board (three kitchen types on a 24-hour track, amber empty hours) and the kitchen/maker 'One shift, by the clock' table come from the product. Everything else is a conventional stack of sections, serif headings and two-column panels.
evidence.proof: The board and the sample listing ('Sample listing. There are no kitchens on Ovenhour yet') are honest, labelled artifacts. But the board is static (no focusable or operable element; the Tab order goes from the hero CTAs straight to 'See county rules'), and the listing sits on the second or third screen (about 2600px down at 390).
evidence.craft: Single 37 KB file with system fonts and no network requests (probe and my offline load: 0 errors and 0 requests at all widths). There is a :root token set, but many raw hex values are scattered through it (#9aa5b3, #c9d1db, #dde3ea, #e6eaf0, #8794a4, #f0b53a) and the status H2 has an inline style. axe at every width: .tag 'Sample' badge contrast 4.49:1 (#8a5c05 on #f6e1a8). The board label 'Prep' renders at 11.84px at 320. Landmarks and heading order are clean (H1 > H2 > H3), there is a skip link, and focus rings (3px amber) show on every Tab stop, including the visually hidden chip checkboxes via the span.
evidence.mobile: 390: no overflow and the board recomposes into name/count over track. There is no menu, though: the nav wraps to a row of four links with 22px-tall targets, chips are 38px tall, and the footer links are 17px. The page runs 7770px long, and the sample listing and maker form are far down. Entering a long unbroken email/place makes the confirmation overflow the page by 2517px at 390.
evidence.honesty: Examples are labelled where they appear ('Typical patterns for three kinds of kitchen, not listings'; 'Sample' tag; '$— per hour'). But the maker form never says before submit that it only opens a mail draft. On submit it hides the form and states 'Noted. We'll email maker@test.example when a kitchen lists hours near Durham...', and only then hedges 'If that email doesn't go through on its own'. Nothing is stored.
evidence.interaction: The only control is the maker form. Empty submit shows role=alert 'We need an email address we can reach and the city and county you cook in.', but focus goes to the City field instead of Email: problems[0].indexOf('email')===0 is never true because the string starts 'an email'. Chips toggle with Space. After success the form is hidden with no edit or reset path (only a reload brings it back). Inputs get no aria-invalid/aria-describedby. Long unbroken input overflows the confirmation (scrollWidth 2867 vs 515). No console errors.
evidence.copy: Specific and from the trade: 'Clean-down finishes by 4:30 am. The morning crew arrives at 5:30', 'Lock-up: hood off, gas valves closed', 'List the hours you're closed, not the hours you'd like to be paid for.' Button text says what it does ('Email me when a kitchen lists'), except that this overstates what the button actually does.
evidence.first_screen: 1440: the H1 fills the left 60% with a large empty right half, and the board only peeks in at y≈790. The promise is a general observation rather than a specific outcome. 390: H1, lede and both CTAs fit, and the board header shows at the bottom. No artifact in view makes the promise believable.

hard_fail_flags.steps: Open packets/P001/A/index.html from disk at 390x844 or 1440x900. Click 'I make food and need a kitchen'. evidence.clarity: The H1 'Kitchens close at ten. Licenses don't.' is a slogan, but the subline right beside it at 1440 (directly below at 390) says exactly what it is and for whom. Each CTA has a 'beside' line saying what happens ('Sign-up is open now. No maker can book yet...'; 'No account. Your note goes to the founders' inbox').
evidence.fit: One shift sheet with a 'Read as: the kitchen / a maker' toggle relabels the same panel ('Makers may use' becomes 'You get', 'House rules' becomes 'You agree to'). County uncertainty: 'We have not chosen launch counties'. Pricing: 'Ovenhour's fee is not set yet'.

evidence.proof: The sheet starts inside the 1440 first screen (y≈500) and is operable. Kitchen mode: clicking Mon 06:00–14:00 turns it to 'held' and the panel updates 9 blocks · 76 h → 8 blocks · 68 h. Maker mode: picking Sun shows 'Sun 18:00–06:00 · 12 h' and '12 h × $38 = $456 at the illustrative price'. evidence.craft:
Separate styles.css with a token layer (colours, s-1..s-7 spacing scale, fonts), a 130-line script with null guards and comments, and system fonts. Offline load from disk: 0 page errors and 0 external requests (probe). axe is clean at 390 and 1440. Flaws: roster block buttons are 30px tall; the artifact has no heading (sheet title and form title are

The sheet is reordered first in the ledger and buttons are full-width at 48px. No overflow at 390 or 320. evidence.honesty: The example is labelled at the top of the sheet ('EXAMPLE LISTING... illustrative'). The form states before submit 'It opens as an email to the founders; nothing is stored here', and the hero says the same. The footer says 'Nothing on this page is a review, a booking count or a partner.' Minor: the subline calls it 'a booking site' while nothing can be booked (the beside text corrects this immediately). evidence.interaction: Every sheet control is a real <button> with aria-pressed and a dynamic aria-label ('Monday 14:00–22:00, 8 hours, held. List it again'). Enter and Space both toggle, the panel is a role=status live region, and the focus ring shows at every stop (Tab path: skip, brand, Menu, both CTAs, mode toggle, 9 blocks, form). No console errors. Edge cases: Escape does not close the open mobile menu. Whitespace-only fields pass native 'required', and the JS then returns without preventDefault, so the form natively submits a blank mailto (body 'county=   ') with no status message. Holding all 9 blocks gives '0 blocks · 0 h', but maker mode has no empty state. Long unbroken county input makes the <pre> preview overflow the page by 2293px at 390.
evidence.copy: Concrete and trade-specific: 'Mark the hours you are dark', 'The equipment list is the contract', 'Counts and sizes, not brands. hard_fail_flags.evidence: The second hero action on this two-sided page, 'Tell us the shift you need' (repeated in the end band), leads to the maker form, whose action is mailto:makers@ovenhour.example. That address is not supplied by the brief, which supplies only ovenhour.example/kitchens. The page does state before submit that it opens an email and stores nothing, so the only ground here is the invented destination address; A uses the same address.
hard_fail_flags.steps: Open packets/P001/B/index.html from disk. Click 'Tell us the shift you need', enter 'Mecklenburg, NC' and 'sourdough', then click 'Send the founders your shift'. The status shows 'Opening your mail app... copy it to makers@ovenhour.example' and the browser navigates to mailto:makers@ovenhour.example?subject=Shift%20wanted%20in%20Mecklenburg%2C%20NC (see script.js line 119 and the form action in index.html line 248).

reason: B delivers an operable, keyboard-accessible two-sided artifact in the first screen, with consistent illustrative numbers, cleaner tokenised CSS and JS, axe-clean output, and a maker action that says before the click what it will do. A's only control is a form that claims a signup it never records, and its artifact is static. B would lose my preference if its sheet failed on touch or keyboard; it did not. Its off-screen mobile feedback and whitespace submit bug are real but smaller than A's misleading confirmation.
